Output Fields:
FIELD DESCRIPTION
responseid Unique ID assigned to every response. Note that all responses will include a response ID.
responsestatus Indicates the status of the response generally starting with phrase "Success: " or "Error: " followed by words if appropriate adding detail.
Identification
aircraftid Unique ID for each aircraft.
modelid ID number of aircraft model associated with the aircraft.
actiondate Last date aircraft record was changed. Returns NULL if no action date.
pageurl Web addresss/URL for referencing details regarding the aircraft in JETNET Evolution. Example: https://www.jetnetevolution.com/DisplayAircraftDetail.aspx?acid=0&jid=0
make The make of the aircraft which typically includes names like Gulfstream, Falcon, Citation, etc.
model Model of the aircraft.
yearmfr Year aircraft was manufactured.
yeardlv Year aircraft was delivered.
maketype Make type of the aircraft returned as JetAirliner, BusinessJet, Turboprop, Piston, or Turbine.
weightclass Weigh class of the aircraft as Heavy, Medium, Light, Very Light.
categorysize Category assigned to the aircraft as Large Jet, Mid-Size Jet, Light Jet, Large Long-Range Jet, Single Engine Piston, etc.
sernbr Serial number assigned to the aircraft.
regnbr Registration number assigned to the aircraft.
regnbrexpires Date that registration number expires (if any)
prevregnbr Previous registration number assigned to the aircraft.
purchasedate Date the aircraft was last purchased.
baseiata IATA code associated with he airport the aircraft is based at.
baseairport Name of airport where aircraft is based.
basecity City where aircraft is based.
basestate State where aircraft is based.
basecountry Country where aircraft is based.
baseairportid ID number of the airport associated with this aircraft (if any). [At some point in the future each airport id may then be used by the getAirport request to obtain more detail]
basefaaid ID number used by FAA to identify the airport for this aircraft.
Status
ownership Indicates the type of ownership on the aircraft such as Whole, Fractional, or Shared.
previouslyowned Indicates if the aircraft is previously owned. If false then the aircraft is assumed to be new.
lifecycle Indicates where in the lifecycle the aircraft is, returned as InProduction, NewWithManufacturer, InOperation, Retired, or InStorage.
usage Identifies how the aircraft is being used if known such as Business, Charter, Medical, Fire Service, Airliner, etc.
forsale Indicates if the aircraft is for sale or not. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
exclusive Indicates if the aircraft is on exclusive or not. Note this result only applies to for sale aircraft. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
leased Indicates if the aircraft is leased or not.
marketstatus Identifies the status of the aircraft relating to the market such as For Sale, Not For Sale, Sale Pending, etc. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
deliverydate Date the aircraft would be delivered. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
asking Wordage associated with what owner is asking for the aircraft if for sale. Includes word 'Price' when an asking price is provided, otherwise may have terms such as Make Offer, Inquire, Autction, Sale/Lease, Trade, etc. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
askingprice Asking price (if any) of the aircraft if for sale. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
listdate Date the aircraft was listed for sale. Note this result only applies to for sale aircraft. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
statusnote Note describing additional details pertinent to this aircraft's market status. Note that this field will not be returned for customers with Aerodex licenses.
Airframe
aftt Airframe total hours for the aircraft as last reported.
landings Airframe total landings/cycles for the aircraft as last reported.
timesasofdate Last date that airframe hours, cycles, and engine times were reported.
estaftt Estimated airframe time based on combination of hours reported and flights for this aircraft.
Engine
onconditiontbo Indicates whether the aircraft is using on condition TBO.
maintenanceprogram Engine maintenance program of the aircraft.
model Engine model for the aircraft.
enginenoiserating Engine noise rating.
engines List of engines and related data associated with this aircraft. Up to 4 depending on the model of the aircraft.
seqnbr Order or sequence number of engines used to list them in order as 1,2,3,4.
serialnum Engine serial number.
ttsnew Engine total time since new.
tbo Engine time between overhaul.
tcsn Engine total cycles since new.
sohhrs Engine Since overhaul hours.
shihrs Engine Since hot inspection hours.
sohcycles Engine Since overhaul cycles.
shscycles Engine Since hot cycles.
APU
model Model of the APU.
sernbr Serial number for the APU.
ttsnew APU total time since new.
soh APU time since overhaul hours.
maintenanceprogram APU maintenance program
Companyrelationships List of relationships that companies have with this aircraft. Note that company relationships associated with market status will not be provided to customers with Aerodex licenses. Aerodex customers will not receive Exclusive Brokers, Sales Company/Contact, etc.
companyid ID number of the company related to the aircraft.
relationtype Relationship of the contact to the aircraft (i.e. Owner, Fractional Owner, Additional Contact, etc.)
contactid ID number of the contact (if any) related to this aircraft.
ownerpercent If relationship is an owner, then returns the percent of the aircraft that the contact owns.
fractionexpiresdate If the relationship of the contact is a fractional owner, then returns the date the fraction is anticipated to expire.
isoperator Indicates whether this contact is assumed to be the operator of this aircraft.
businesstype Indicates the primary business type that of the contact that is related to the aircraft.
Maintenance Indicates how the aircraft is maintained such as FAR Part 135, FAR Part 129, FAR Part 121, etc.
airframemaintenanceprogram The airframe maintenance program (if any) for the aircraft.
certifications List of certifications (if any) associated with the aircraft such as B-RNAV, NAT-MNPS, RNP-#, RVSM, etc.
notes General maintenance notes associated with the aircraft.
weightscapacity Weights and capacity figures associated with the aircraft such as Ramp, MTOW, Landing, BOW, & Empty.
damagestatus Indicates if the aircraft has had damage.
damagenotes Describes the damage that has occurred on the aircraft.
maintenanceitems List of individual maintenance items/inspections associated with the aircraft.
name Maintenance item.
compliedwithdate Complied with date or hours.
duedate Due date or hours.
notes Additional notes associated with the maintenance item such as who completed the action.
Avionics List of avionics associated with a given aircraft.
name Type of avionics.
description Description of avionics.
Features List of features associated with a given aircraft.
name Name of the feature associated with the aircraft.
code Unique 3-character code associated with this feature. Used when reports do not have room to show the entire name.
status Status associated with the aircraft feature as Equipped With, Standard Equipment, Not Equipped With
Additional Equipment List of additional equipment associated with a given aircraft.
name Type of equipment detail such as General, Cockpit, Lights, Modification, etc.
description Description of the equipment details associated with the type.
Interior List of interior details associated with a given aircraft including items such as passengers, configuration, last done, done by, etc.
name Type of interior detail such as General, Seating, Entertainment, Lavatory, Business, Configuration, Passengers, Last done, etc
description Description of the interior details associated with the name.
Exterior List of exterior details associated with a given aircraft.
name Type of exterior detail such as Colors.
description Description of the exterior details associated with the type.
Leases List of leases associated with this aircraft including both active and expired leases.
date Date of the lease.
description Description of the lease including description of lessor and lessee.
status Last reported status of the lease as 'Active' or 'Expired'
type The type of lease including terms like Wet, Dry, etc.
term Length/term of the lease such as 120-Month, 10-Year, etc.
note Additional notes regarding the lease.
expirationdate Date lease will expire (if known).
Flights List of flights and hours per month for the current aircraft for the last 12 months and month to date.
flightyear Year of the summary record for flights per month.
flightmonth Month of the summary record for flights per month.
flights Number of flights during the month.
flighthours Number of hours during the month.
Pictures
imageid Unique ID assigned to each aircraft picture.
description Description of the aircraft picture such as Exterior, Interior, Cockpit, Galley, Lavatory.
extension The type of aircraft picture like JPG, GIF, SVG.
pictureurl URL for referencing aircraft picture from Evolution AWS S3 Bucket : expires in (60) minutes.
